name: raw_model_scores_202501_202608
execution: AutoDL only; local workstation authors code and renders reports
signal: Original factor column from frozen model inference, without clipping, standardization or industry/style neutralization
portfolio: Equal weight within top/bottom quintiles; target long +100% and short -100% of post-fee NAV
buffer: Retain existing longs in top 30% and shorts in bottom 30%, then fill each side to 20%; equal weight daily
rank_mean: Daily cross-sectional percentile of raw model scores; trailing five trading sessions t-5 through t-1 for trading at t open; finite mean with expanding warmup and prior-session eligibility
execution_time: Signal after close, trade at next open; hold continuously including overnight; last available open reserved for liquidation
marking: Daily adjusted close; missing close uses current known opening mark, missing open blocks trading and uses previous known close/mark
annualization: 252 times arithmetic mean of daily close-to-close portfolio returns across all 402 sessions, including initial cash day
sharpe: sqrt(252) times daily mean divided by sample standard deviation (ddof=1); risk-free rate zero; net Sharpe at stated fees
turnover: Daily (buy notional + sell notional)/(2 * pre-trade opening NAV), including initial/terminal trading; mean over all 402 sessions
scope: Retrospective comparison of three already selected rules; no parameter search or claim of independent strategy-selection out-of-sample performance
